# platform-orchestrator_stable_module_version_successor (Resource)

Atomically publishes one complete stable Proposed Module Version and deprecates its exact Proposed prerelease. Terraform destroy forgets this immutable operation receipt and never reverses lifecycle history.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) Complete JSON ModuleVersionPublishBody for the separate stable Version.
- `expected_prerelease_resource_version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version of the prerelease.
- `module_id` (String)
- `prerelease_version_id` (String) Exact Proposed prerelease UUID or canonical SemVer.
- `reason` (String) Reason recorded while deprecating the prerelease.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Atomic lifecycle correlation UUID.
- `prerelease_version_uuid` (String)
- `stable_version_uuid` (String)
